About

Alessandro Salo.

Utrecht, NL· he / him

I am committed to making games beautiful. Not necessarily graphically - despite aspiring to be a graphics/engine programmer - but as experiences. I want to make them beautiful, not necessarily by making the games, but by being part of the pipeline that allows designers to put pen onto paper.

I'm currently a Game and Media Technology student in Utrecht, with a background in physics and mathematics. A while ago I used to think that I would go into computational physics research, which is why I spent a year at EPFL studying computational science and engineering.

After reconnecting with games and real-time graphics, I realized that graphics programming and engine development was where my true passion lay — leading me back to Utrecht to pursue high-performance rendering and tool development.

Focus Areas

Real-Time Rendering — Physically-based rendering, ray tracing, spatial data structures (BVHs), and GPU pipeline optimizations.

Engine Architecture — Designing clean low-level systems in modern C++ and Rust for game engine tooling.

Mathematics & Simulation — Leveraging a strong background in physics and applied math to solve complex geometry and lighting problems.
